The minting node runs h9k 0.13.0; the other nodes\\u0027 versions are unconfirmed.\\n\\nSteps:\\n1. On a successor node, \\u0060h9k project invite \\u003Cproject\\u003E --role owner\\u0060. It mints without complaint.\\n2. On a brand-new teammate node, \\u0060h9k project join \\u003Cproject\\u003E --invite \\u003Csecret\\u003E\\u0060.\\n3. The minting node\\u0027s sweep matches the proof. \\u0060h9k status\\u0060 there shows \\u0022Waiting on invite \\u003Cid\\u003E\\u0027s own member write, requested \\u003Ctime\\u003E... the root node may need h9k update\\u0022.\\n4. Within minutes the line becomes \\u0022Expired invite \\u003Cid\\u003E\\u0027s own member write, re-mint the invite.\\u0022\\n5. \\u0060h9k project member approve \\u003Cproject\\u003E \\u003Cinvite-id\\u003E\\u0060 fails with \\u0022No owner-role write held for invite...\\u0022 on the minting node and on the operator\\u0027s other node (presumed root). There is never anything to approve anywhere.\\n\\nEffect: the teammate\\u0027s node keeps sending, and every sweep logs \\u0022outbox could not be vouched for by that node\\u0027s own node file\\u0022. The join never finishes.
